name: Hawkins Cookers Limited
summary: Hawkins Cookers Limited manufactures, trades, and sells kitchenware in India and internationally. The company offers pressure cookers; and cookware, including tavas, frying pans, deep-fry pans, saucepans, cook-n-serve bowls, handis, stewpots, sauté pans, Uttapam pan, Tpan, casserole and mini casserole, appe pan, grill pan, dutch ovens, shallow kadhai, pizza makers and cake bakers, spatula, and cookware sets, as well as offers kitchen electricals and accessories; and parts and repair services for its products.
